scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level (Sainik Welfare)
description:
The Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Sports is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India to support the children of ex-servicemen who excel in sports at national and international levels. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2017. 

It aims to recognize and encourage the sporting talent of the wards of ex-servicemen. 

The scheme is part of the broader efforts by the Ministry of Defence to provide welfare benefits to the families of those who have served in the armed forces. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious sports persons who are children of ex-servicemen. 

The scheme aims to promote sports and physical fitness among the youth, particularly those from military families. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to help cover the costs associated with training, equipment, and participation in competitions. 

The amount of financial assistance varies based on the level of achievement in sports. 

For national-level achievements, a grant of ₹20,000 is provided. 

For international-level achievements, the grant amount increases to ₹50,000. 

This financial support is aimed at alleviating some of the financial burdens associated with pursuing sports at a competitive level. 

Eligibility for this scheme is specifically targeted at the wards of ex-servicemen. 

The term "wards" includes children and dependents of ex-servicemen. 

The applicants must be under the age of 25 years at the time of application. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this grant. 

However, the applicant must have achieved a recognized level of performance in sports. 

This performance must be validated by appropriate sports authorities or federations. 

The application process is straightforward but requires specific documentation. 

Applicants must submit a duly filled application form to the respective Zila Sainik Board. 

The application form can typically be obtained from the Zila Sainik Board or downloaded from the official website. 

Along with the application form, applicants must provide proof of their relationship with the ex-serviceman. 

This can be in the form of a discharge certificate or any other relevant document. 

Additionally, a certificate of achievement in sports must be included. 

This certificate should be issued by the recognized sports authority or federation. 

Other supporting documents may include identity proof and address proof. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the Zila Sainik Board. 

The board will verify the documents and the achievements claimed by the applicant. 

If everything is in order, the grant is approved and disbursed. 

The disbursement of the grant typically occurs within a few weeks of approval. 

The scheme is implemented through the Zila Sainik Boards across various states in India. 

These boards are responsible for the welfare of ex-servicemen and their families. 

Each state has its own Zila Sainik Board which operates under the Ministry of Defence. 

The contact details for these boards can be found on the official Ministry of Defence website. 

The scheme encourages participation in various sports disciplines recognized by the Indian government. 

These include athletics, swimming, badminton, boxing, and many others. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception in 2017. 

Many wards of ex-servicemen have benefited from this financial assistance. 

The government aims to increase awareness about this scheme among ex-servicemen and their families. 

Promotional activities are conducted to ensure that eligible applicants are informed about the benefits available. 

The scheme is part of a larger initiative to promote sports in India. 

The Indian government has been increasingly focusing on sports development in recent years. 

This includes initiatives like the Khelo India scheme which aims to promote sports at the grassroots level. 

The Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports complements these efforts by providing targeted support to a specific demographic. 

The scheme also aligns with the government's vision of fostering a culture of sports and fitness in the country. 

By supporting the wards of ex-servicemen, the government acknowledges their contributions to the nation. 

The scheme also aims to inspire other youth to take up sports seriously. 

It serves as a recognition of the sacrifices made by ex-servicemen and their families. 

The financial assistance provided can significantly impact the sporting careers of the beneficiaries. 

It allows them to access better training facilities and coaching. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of ex-servicemen and their families. 

It highlights the importance of sports in building character and discipline among the youth. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of this scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The aim is to ensure that the scheme remains relevant and beneficial to those it serves. 

Overall, the Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports is a significant step towards supporting the sporting aspirations of the children of ex-servicemen. 

It provides a much-needed financial boost that can help them achieve their goals in sports. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's recognition of the importance of sports in national development. 

It encourages a spirit of competition and excellence among the youth of India. 

The initiative not only helps in nurturing talent but also promotes a healthy lifestyle among the wards of ex-servicemen. 

As sports continue to gain prominence in India, schemes like this play a crucial role in shaping the future of aspiring athletes. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of ex-servicemen and their families through various initiatives. 

This scheme is just one of many that reflect this commitment. 

The ongoing support for sports and physical fitness is expected to yield positive results in the coming years. 

The government aims to create a robust sports culture that includes all sections of society. 

Through this scheme, the wards of ex-servicemen are given a platform to shine in the world of sports. 

The financial assistance provided is a stepping stone towards achieving greater heights in their sporting careers. 

The scheme is a vital part of the government's broader strategy to promote sports and physical education in India. 

It is essential for the development of a healthy and active population.
